summary: GSK plc files a Form 6-K reporting a routine transaction by a PDMR (Chief People Officer Diana Conrad) who acquired 65.267 American Depositary Shares at $58.3499 each via reinvested dividends on shares held in the GSK pension plan on April 13, 2026. This is a standard notification of director/PDMR shareholding under UK market rules, not a special situation. No strategic event, acquisition, divestiture, or corporate action is involved. The filing is informational only and requires no market action.
